updates.text: An official audit confirmed that AeroLink Charter does not hold a valid Civil Aviation Authority licence.

policies.text: Safety clearance for commercial flights requires a carrier to possess a Civil Aviation Authority licence and maintain a fleet size of at least 10 aircraft.
Maritime cargo clearance is granted to any shipping line maintaining a vessel capacity of at least 500 TEU.
An air carrier receives tier-one charter status provided it has obtained safety clearance for commercial flights.
Selection as chief event carrier is assigned to a service provider holding tier-one charter status.
Preferred fleet standing is awarded to a coach operator completing a minimum of 400 long-distance trips annually.
Priority rail scheduling is assigned to a freight firm logging over 1,000 cargo movements per month.
